note: Recorded language tier conformance runs (PX-027, docs/76). A language appears here only after the tier suites passed on its real fixture repository; the suite test named in each record regenerates and checks this file, so it cannot claim more than the suites proved. A language that is absent is Unsupported. A record is what a tier claim rests on: promoting a language into a tier in the product's labels is PX-028, and it may cite nothing but these records.

the headless language service returns symbols and finds a known reference
the language service reports the defect the build reports, in the same file
